name: Richter
statusNote: Working engine with launchers and a design manifest; later folded into Spectrum alongside its siblings, so this repo stands as the predecessor.
oneLiner: A Node news-monitoring bot that scores world headlines for magnitude with a local LLM and posts placard cards to Discord plus a broadsheet dashboard.

components.name: prefilter
components.desc: Cheap lexicon gate before any LLM call — includes neutral and positive terms so it isn't all doom.

components.name: analyze
components.desc: Ollama call that coerces model output into a fixed schema with safe defaults.

components.name: placard
components.desc: Renders a parchment-style card image via canvas, with a plain-embed fallback.

components.name: discord
components.desc: Webhook poster with a custom User-Agent that respects rate limits.

components.name: serve.js + web/
components.desc: Local broadsheet-style dashboard served from stored feed data.

components.name: tools/
components.desc: Dry-run, test-post, sample-feed, and placard-test utilities.

dataFlow: Around 15 world and politics RSS feeds are fetched on a loop.
A lexicon prefilter drops obvious non-stories before any LLM call.
Survivors go to a local Ollama model for a structured read: arena, heat, virality, stakes, confidence, stage.
Not-newsworthy items are dropped; magnitude is computed as virality times confidence.
A parchment placard card is rendered for each surviving story.
Cards post to Discord on a metered drip (default one card per four minutes) and are written to a local feed store.
The dashboard server renders a broadsheet view from that stored data.
If Ollama is unreachable, a lexicon-only fallback read runs — always labeled low-confidence and degraded.
decisions: A blank card beats a false alarm — low-confidence reads never post unlabeled.
Politically neutral by design: the lexicon is a bouncer, not an editor; the LLM does the judging.
Deliberately paced drip posting so the channel is never flooded.
Every model-output field is coerced to a known enum with safe defaults — malformed LLM JSON never throws.
Same engine shape as Macroscope, different lens — market impact there, world drama here.
